'''Jawoyn''' (Jawonj, Jawany, Djauan, Jawan, Jawony; Adowen, Gun-djawan), also known as '''Kumertuo''', is a moribund [[Gunwinyguan languages|Gunwinyguan language]] spoken only by elders in [[Arnhem Land]], Australia.
